title: Lining, bututu, ɗaure da cikakkun bayanai waɗanda ke da aminci

say: Lining, bututu, ɗaure da cikakkun bayanai waɗanda ke da aminci.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module huɗu na Ƙarshen Kayayyakin Kaya da Kula da Inganci.
Rufi yana rufe sutura, yana dakatar da yadin da aka saka ko sequins yana taɓa fata, kuma yana taimaka wa suturar ta rataye. Bututun bututu da dauri shaci da gama gefuna.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Ta'aziyya a ciki, bambanci a waje

Amintaccen aiki yana kare mutuncin ku

say: Beads, yadin da aka saka da appliqué suna jujjuya tufa guda ɗaya zuwa wani yanki. Amma beads da ke faɗowa a filin rawa suna lalata sunan ku. Bambance-bambancen shine a cikin daidaitawa, tsaro da dubawa.

say: Rufin polyester yana da santsi kuma mai araha, amma yana iya jin zafi da ɗanɗano a cikin zafin Najeriya. Viscose ko cupro yana numfashi kuma yana ɗimuwa kamar siliki, amma yana da tsada kuma yana iya raguwa, don haka kafin a wanke ko tururi.

panel.heading: Daidaita rufin tufafi da yanayi
items: Polyester: mai araha, amma yana iya jin zafi
Viscose ko cupro: numfashi, drapes da kyau
Cotton voile: haske da sanyi don sawar rana
Satin ko taffeta: amarya da maraice
Rufin shimfiɗa: don shimfiɗa riguna

say: Cotton voile yana da kyau ga suturar yara da riguna na rana. Satin ya dace da kayan amarya da kayan yamma. Kuma rigar da aka shimfiɗa tana buƙatar lilin da ke shimfiɗawa kamar masana'anta na waje.

say: Lining ya ɗan miƙe ya zauna a ciki, don haka suna buƙatar ƙarin ɗaki kaɗan. Yanke daga irin wannan tsari, amma a dinka suturar lilin a tsaye 3 zuwa 5 mm a cikin layin suturar sutura.

panel.heading: Dole ne rufin ya taɓa ja
items: Dinka madaidaitan madauri kadan kadan
Hem 2 zuwa 2.5 cm sama da gefen siket
Ninka 3 zuwa 5 mm nesa da zip nada
Faransanci yana da tsayin 2 zuwa 3 cm a gindi
panel.rule: Dinka gefen sutura mai ƙarami 3 zuwa 5 mm, don ƙarin sauƙi.

say: Yi alama a saman shingen da ke kusa da 2 zuwa 2.5 cm sama da gefen siket, don haka ba zai taɓa fitowa ba. A zip ɗin, ninka labulen 3 zuwa 5 mm nesa da coil ɗin kuma ku zame shi, don haka madaidaicin ba zai taɓa kama shi ba.

panel.heading: Dole ne rufin ya taɓa ja

say: Kashe yadudduka daban-daban, kuma haɗa su a gefen gefe tare da takin Faransanci, sarƙar zaren tsayin 2 zuwa 3 cm wanda zai ba da damar rufin ya motsa.

Misali, Patience a Abeokuta ta ga yadin da aka saka yana murzawa a kan cinyar abokin ciniki. Ta sake sake dinke ginshiƙan gefen rufin 4 mm gaba a ciki, ta sami kusan 1.6 cm zagaye kwatangwalo, yadin da aka saka a santsi.

say: Ana yin bututu da ɗaure daga raƙuman son rai, a yanka a digiri 45, don haka suna lanƙwasa a kusa da masu lankwasa. Ninka madaidaicin yanke gefen ƙasa zuwa selvedge. Nadin diagonal shine ainihin son zuciya.

panel.heading: Rahila ta bugi kaftan wuya
items: Ninka gefen yanke zuwa kan kai: son zuciya na gaskiya
Igiyar 4 mm x 3.14 = kusan 1.3 cm zagaye
Layin wuya 64 + 6 cm = 70 cm tsayi
Clip a kan masu lankwasa; kabu na ƙarshe kusa da igiya

say: Misali, Rahila a Abuja tana amfani da igiyar mm hudu. Dawafinsa yana da kusan 1.3 cm. Ƙara izinin kabu biyu na 1.5 cm: 4.3 cm. Ta yanke 4.5 cm don sauƙi mai sauƙi.

panel.rule: Faɗin bututu = kewayen igiya + izinin kabu biyu.

say: Layin wuyansa shine 64 cm, da kusan 6 cm don haɗawa, don haka tsayin 70 cm. Ta ƙulla bututun a kan masu lankwasa, sannan ta ɗinka ɗinkin ƙarshe kaɗan kusa da igiyar, don haka ɗinkin farko yana ɓoye.

say: Yi amfani da bututu don zayyana wani ɗinki. Yana nunawa azaman layi mai tasowa.

panel.heading: Zayyana wani dinki, ko gama da gefe
left: Yana nunawa azaman layi mai tasowa
Yana buƙatar igiya da ƙafar zip

say: Yi amfani da ɗaure don gama gefe, kamar layin wuya. Daure mai ninki biyu yana buƙatar kusan ninki huɗu da aka gama, don haka kusan 4 cm don ɗaurin 1 cm. Mikewa shi dan kadan a kusa da lanƙwasa na ciki, sa'annan ku haɗa ɗigo tare da digon diagonal don guje wa dunƙulewa.

say: Sanya stabilizer a bayan appliqué, beading da embodier don kada tushen tushe ya yi tsiro. Rufe gefuna appliqué tare da madaidaicin satin kusa, faɗin 2 zuwa 3 mm.

panel.heading: Ado wanda ya tsaya akan
items: Stabilizer bayan kowane motif
Satin dinki yana rufe gefuna appliqué
Backstitch kowane beads 3 ko 4
Babu dogon zaren da ke yawo a baya
Yi ado lebur, kafin ɗinki

say: A kiyaye zaren kowane ƙullun 3 ko 4 tare da ɗan ƙaramin baya, don haka idan zaren ya karye, ƙananan beads kawai sun faɗi. Kada ku ɗauki zaren dogon nisa a baya. Dogayen iyo ya kama kuma ya karye.

say: Kawata sassa lebur, kafin a dinka rigunan, barin kusan 2 cm a sarari a kowane kabu.
Yawancin beads da sequins ba za su iya ɗaukar ƙarfe mai zafi ba. Danna su kawai daga baya, a kan tawul mai kauri tare da zanen latsa, kuma gaya wa abokin ciniki yadda ake tsaftace tufafin.

panel.rule: Danna wuraren ƙawata kawai daga baya, akan tawul mai kauri.

say: Farashin kayan ado na kayan aiki daga samfurin lokaci. Wuyan Fatima 60cm yana da sassan 12 na 5 cm. A minti 20 kowanne, wato minti 240, wato awa 4.
Tana kimanta lokacinta akan kusan naira 1,500 a awa daya, don haka aiki naira 6,000 ne.
Kayayyakin sun kai kimanin naira 4,000.
Don haka kwalliyar ta kara kusan Naira 10,000, kuma ta bayyana wannan kudin daban ga wanda ya ke so.

Don tunawa. Ka ba da labule mai sauƙi, kuma ka rufe su sama da gefen tufa. Yanke igiyoyin son zuciya a digiri 45 don masu lankwasa. Secure beads kowane 3 ko 4. Kuma farashin ƙawa daga lokaci samfurori da kayan.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Ba da rufin ƙarin sauƙi
Girman shinge na 2 zuwa 2.5 cm sama da ƙafar
Yanke son zuciya a digiri 45 don masu lankwasa
Tsare kowane beads 3 ko 4
Ƙawata farashin daga samfuran lokaci

say: Yanzu rubuta tsarin sutura don tufafi biyu kuma ku yi takin Faransanci. Yi samfurin bututu da ɗaure. Sa'an nan kuma yi samfurin appliqué da beading, lokaci da kanka, da kuma farashin 60 cm wuyan wuyansa.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
